summary: Don't offer queues a patient is already in
description:
The queue entry form offers queues the patient already has an active entry in. Those entries cannot be duplicated, so the only outcome of picking one is a failed submit and the user only finds out after filling in the queue location, service and priority.
Steps to reproduce
Go to Home > Service queues and select the "Outpatient Clinic" queue location.

Note a patient listed under "Attending" — e.g. Susan Lopez (CR Number 100001W), inOutpatient Consultation.

In the Waiting List, click "Add a patient to this list" and search for the patient.

Select them, keep the prefilled Queue Location and pick Outpatient Consultation as theService, then click "Add patient to queue".

Expected
The form does not offer queues the patient is already in:
Service lists only queues at the selected location that the patient is not already in.

Queue Location omits a location once the patient is in every queue there.

A location with no queues configured is still listed, so that misconfiguration keeps surfacing as "No services configured".

Queues at other locations are unaffected — the patient can still be queued elsewhere.

Actual
Outpatient Consultation is offered, and submitting produces:
Error updating queue entry
Server responded with 400 (Bad Request) for url /openmrs/ws/rest/v1/visit-queue-entry
